items.title: Did Binance’s $6.3 Billion Crypto Hack Just Expose an Even Bigger Risk for Bitcoin Investors?
items.summary: Binance lost billions to hackers yet dodged a customer run, while Bitcoin ETFs that were never touched bled over $1 billion in two sessions. Something else may be driving the exodus, and the timeline tells a different story.
